title: Avila Core Log Record v0.1 draft
description: The envelope one non-run record (ADR-0019: design revision, assessment, named reference, contract amendment, or ADR-0021 attestation/state-transition) occupies in a campaign JSONL log. The record payload is validated by the schema named by record_kind; the envelope adds the append timestamp and an optional ADR-0015 signature.

signature.description: An ADR-0015 detached Ed25519 signature over this exact line's canonical bytes.
